Ukraine Claims Russia Using North Korean Troops and Missiles

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed that Russia is preparing for escalation by bringing in North Korean military equipment and potentially deploying up to 50,000 North Korean soldiers. Zelenskyy also stated that Russia fired North Korean missiles in an overnight strike. Separately, Ukrainian officials reported that a drone strike in central Russia killed 12 people and injured 39. The coverage also mentions Ukraine turning over proposals to U.S. negotiators for a plan to end the war.
